about_the_game:
Add-on for Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth, featuring an assortment of materials for crafting and strengthening weapons at Julie's Gearworks.

* This set can only be purchased once.

Includes:
Lustrous Steel (Single-Use Special) x 150

Electric Crystal (Single-Use Special) x 50
Lava Crystal (Single-Use Special) x 50
Ice Crystal (Single-Use Special) × 50
Rainbow Crystal (Single-Use Special) x 50

Squid Tentacles (Single-Use Special) ×5

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Blood, Intense Violence, Sexual Themes, Strong Language, and Use of Tobacco and Alcohol.
